title: Forced-Term Modeling in the Koopman Framework for Linear Operator Learning in Nonlinear Dynamical Systems
summary: We study the problem of extracting reliable and interpretable linear models from nonlinear dynamical systems with periodic behavior. Dynamic Mode Decomposition (DMD) is a widely used data-driven method for approximating dynamics by a linear system and is commonly interpreted through Koopman operator theory. However, because standard DMD assumes linear evolution in the chosen observables, it can produce misleading results on nonlinear systems.
